questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

d _ eeffggddeeffggdde _ ffggddeeffggddeef _ __g__ _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: d _ eeffggddeeffggdde _ ffggddeeffggddeef _ __g__ _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) deff → d__d__eeffgg / ddeeffgg / dde__e__ffgg / ddeeffgg ddeef__f____gf__

Option 2) ddee → d__d__eeffgg / ddeeffgg / dde__d__ffgg / ddeeffgg ddeef__e____ge__

**Option 3) defg **→ d**__d__**eeffgg / ddeeffgg / dde__**e**__ffgg / ddeeffgg ddeef__**f**____g**g**__

Here, 'ddeeffgg' followed a pattern.

Option 4) degf → d__d__eeffgg / ddeeffgg / dde__e__ffgg / ddeeffgg ddeef__g____gf__

Hence, the correct answer is "**defg**".

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

× and ÷

I. 16 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 + 7

II. 8 ÷ 4 - 9 × 3 + 8
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given: × and ÷

I. 16 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 + 7

After interchanging the given two signs we get:

⇒ 16 × 4 - __**8 ÷ 2**__ + 7

⇒ __**16 × 4**__ - 4 + 7

⇒ __64__ - 4 __**+ 7**__

⇒ __**71 - 4**__ = **67**

II. 8 ÷ 4 - 9 × 3 + 8 

After interchanging the given two signs we get:

⇒ 8 × 4 - __**9 ÷ 3**__ + 8

⇒ __**8 × 4**__ - 3 + 8

⇒ __32__ - 3 __**+ 8**__

⇒ __**40 - 3**__ = 37

Hence, the correct answer is "**67 and 37**".
